_comment: What version this copy is. The same file on GitHub is what an update check compares against, so the two are always the same shape. Bump it in the commit that releases, and add the matching section to CHANGELOG.md. Three other places carry this number too -- .claude-plugin/plugin.json, the marketplace entry beside it, and the git tag -- and 'claude plugin tag' checks that they agree.
_headline: One sentence, spoken aloud when an update is found. Write it for the ear.
headline: Windows had been quietly deleting the speaking engine out of your Downloads folder after thirty days, and the installer was the one that put it there. It moves it somewhere safe now.
_notes: The two or three things worth hearing about this release. The full account lives in CHANGELOG.md.
notes: The engine was being installed into your Downloads folder, and Windows empties that folder of anything untouched for thirty days. It did. The voice then failed to start, naming a path that had been right for weeks.

The installer put it there in the first place: it looked in Downloads before anywhere else and settled wherever it found a copy. It now moves that copy somewhere Windows will not sweep, and the second installer warns you instead of recording a path with a month to live.
Worth re-running setup for this one. If your engine is sitting in Downloads right now, that is what moves it out, and a plain update will not.
_needsSetup: true when a release changes the slash command, the hooks or the notes -- the parts a pull alone does not reinstall.
